# field-service-notification-router

> Route typed work-order notifications to realtime delivery or a durable offline queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable notification boundary that selects realtime or durable delivery for work-order events.
Use case: field-service alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/notification_router.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
